candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately after successful calls instead of true at the end.
Invert the final returned boolean: return false when loop runs, otherwise true (changes returned value for any non-empty _tos).
Return the success check of the last call instead of always true (store last _s and return it).
Return logical AND of all call successes instead of always true (collect _s without require on failure).
Change the call to transferFrom to use the value v as the amount parameter only for the first _tos entry and 0 for subsequent entries, which can alter state observed after transfer calls complete.
Invert the order of calls by iterating the _tos array in reverse, changing which addresses receive transfers first and thus potentially altering final observable state.
Replace require(_tos.length > 0) with an allow-all (removed requirement) so transfer proceeds for empty _tos, which changes observed behavior when callers pass empty arrays.
